hypotheses.falsified_if: The paired CI is inconclusive, or it favors cold at the declared 0.5 J threshold.
hypotheses.label: hypothesis
hypotheses.statement: Diverse warm-start CMA reaches a lower frozen v4 J than broad cold CMA at the same budget on native__ath_core_v4.

hypotheses.falsified_if: The paired CI excludes zero at the declared threshold in either direction.
hypotheses.label: hypothesis
hypotheses.statement: Warm start and cold start are indistinguishable at this pilot budget.

practical_improvement.label: declared_practical_threshold_not_a_speedup_claim
practical_improvement.rationale: 0.5 J is roughly 5% of the native replay median (~10 J in the R0 native scores).  It is a declared pilot planning threshold, not a protocol constant or a promise of improvement.

analysis_plan.primary_endpoint: Frozen v4 J at the declared equal budget (18 valid screen + 6 verify).

results_parser.censoring: Right-censored at the declared budget/attempt cap; censored pairs remain in the denominator and are never counted as reached.
results_parser.note: A solver failure, a cheap pre-BEM refusal and an unclassified row are distinct outcomes.  None becomes J=1000 or a silent pass.
results_parser.verify_calls: Reported separately when mode=verify is recorded; otherwise null with verify_calls_unknown=true.

analysis_plan.stopping_rule: Predeclared paired analysis: d = A - B per seed pair; bootstrap 95% CI of the mean paired difference with right-censoring at the declared budget and attempt cap.  Declare a_better only if the CI upper bound is below -0.5 J, b_better only if the CI lower bound is above +0.5 J, otherwise inconclusive. Fewer than five complete pairs is pilot_only, not a significance guarantee.

arms.config_overlay_note: Existing config-schema keys only.  A reviewed runner must materialize this overlay before dispatch; this tool never writes examples/ or any live config.
arms.label: broad cold CMA (config seed, no warm start)

verification.selection_rule: Up to four distinct screen finalists by frozen J, then two uniformly selected remaining eligible screened designs from the reserved audit RNG seed; no duplicates or already-verified specs.

arms.config_overlay_note: Existing config-schema keys only (search.budget_counts, search.max_attempts, search.warm_start).  warm_start is validated by the normal config loader at execution time; it refuses family/objective/brief/knob-name mismatches.
arms.label: diverse warm-start CMA (top-k spread from two native runs)

verification.selection_rule: Same verification allocation as the cold arm: up to four distinct screen finalists by frozen J, then two uniformly selected remaining eligible screened designs from the reserved audit RNG seed.

cost_accounting.note: An attempt is reserved before dispatch.  A crash/unknown attempt keeps its reservation until reconciled; a retry reserves another unit.  Cache hits retain elapsed cost but do not consume a new-BEM count.

per_arm_per_replicate.screen_semantics: search.budget_counts: valid means the 18 budget units count VALID screen evaluations; deterministic refusals consume the 120-attempt cap, not the 18-valid budget.

replication_aggregate.note: Arithmetic expansion of the 25-seed paired schedule.  This aggregate is a planning figure only; no execution is authorized by this manifest.

cpu_if_beat_cpu.rule: If the owner selects beat_cpu, the study runner must explicitly hold runs/.cpu.lane.lock.  The current CLI _solve_lock is a null context for CPU because the night runner owns the CPU lock.  gpu-clean and night hygiene must not touch hosts of a lane whose lock is live.

gpu.note: The study runner must own the GPU lock for the full serial run.  Never clean hosts from another or an unknown lane.

no_default_changes.statement: No default, objective version, score tolerance/weight, registration, cache/dataset or GUI/CLI change is made or implied.  This is a prepare-only scratch manifest; overlays are not applied.

notes: Both arms use the same physical task, brief, scoring identity, grid, backend and budget policy.  The only intentional treatment difference is the CMA initial mean/sigma: cold uses the config seed; warm uses search.warm_start from two local native__ath_core_v4 screen runs (same family, objective v4, brief and searched knob names).  The overlay is never applied by this tool.
question: Hypothesis (not a claim): on the frozen native__ath_core_v4 task, a diverse warm-start CMA arm reaches a lower frozen v4 J at the same 18-valid-screen / 6-verify / 24-new-BEM budget than a broad cold CMA arm.  No speedup or improvement is promised; a no-gain or inconclusive result is a valid result.

pairing.difference_definition: d = A - B (negative => A has lower J / is better)
pairing.note: Pair seed 5101 in the cold arm with seed 5101 in the warm arm, etc.  A shared CMA seed is not proof of shared candidates; pairing is valid only because it is predeclared here.  Resume segments/restarts inside one run dir are one replicate, not extra seeds.

run_order.note: Alternate arm order by seed index (odd cold-first, even warm-first) or predeclare a fixed random permutation before the first dispatch and record it.  Never run the two arms concurrently: the GPU lane is serial.

fail_or_no_gain_rollback: Preparing or validating this manifest changes no production default, objective version, tolerance/weight, cache/dataset behavior, GUI/CLI behavior or registration.
If the pilot is not scheduled, discard the scratch overlay; no live file was written.
If warm start fails to beat cold at the declared threshold, do not adopt it; keep search.warm_start absent in production configs.
If the pilot is inconclusive, do not silently widen the budget; a larger study is a new revision with its own review.
A cancellation or crash preserves partial results; unknown attempts are reconciled, never relaunched automatically.

owner_adoption_decisions.adopt_if: Prospective paired evidence is a_better with CI upper < -0.5 J and no increase in new-BEM cost.
owner_adoption_decisions.decision: Adopt diverse warm start for native__ath_core_v4
owner_adoption_decisions.otherwise: Keep cold start; do not change the config.

owner_adoption_decisions.adopt_if: Pilot paired variability supports a power plan at the declared 0.5 J delta.
owner_adoption_decisions.otherwise: Stop at the pilot; no budget creep or silent threshold change.

owner_adoption_decisions.adopt_if: This pilot is not a verification-allocation experiment; the protocol default remains in force.
owner_adoption_decisions.otherwise: If allocation becomes the question, prepare a separate revision (pilot 2 pattern).

block_estimate.basis: 18 valid screen BEM calls + 6 verify calls; expected attempts to reach 18 valid evaluations are approximately 19 at the measured 2-5% cheap-refusal rate.  Verify fidelity (1024 balloon points) has no measured timing; the range assumes 1x-2x the screen per-BEM cost.

caveats: Measured on historical native screen runs (2026-10-27 / 2026-11-13), not on this pilot; host/cache state is not controlled.
d37d64 wall_span is 29,216 s because of pauses; use its accumulated candidate cost (~3,697 s), not wall span.
Verify-fidelity cost is unmeasured; the 1x-2x multiplier is an assumption, not a measurement.
Warm-start arm timing may differ from cold; no warm-start timing was measured.
Arithmetic extrapolation only; not a speedup claim.  Real scheduling uses owner availability and a required deadline.
runtime_estimates.method: Measured S3-style cost ledgers of two local native__ath_core_v4 screen runs, then arithmetic extrapolation to the declared 24-call block.  No speedup is claimed.

budget.rule: Stop dispatching at 24 new BEM calls or 120 new attempts for an arm/seed block, whichever comes first; preserve partial results and the attempt journal.

cancellation.rule: An explicit cancellation stops future dispatch, cancels only the owned lane/process tree, and preserves partial results.  CPU analysis/proposal work never invokes GPU cleanup.

deadline.rule: A wall deadline must be chosen from comparable measured logs and owner availability before real scheduling.  This prepared manifest leaves the deadline as an explicit placeholder.

infrastructure_failures.rule: Stop after three consecutive infrastructure/solver-host failures; an unknown in-flight attempt retains its reservation and is reconciled, not relaunched automatically.

pool_exhaustion.rule: If the legal candidate pool has no novel candidate after the declared retries, stop with pool_exhausted; do not widen bounds or fabricate a design.

stale_package.rule: Stop if the manifest revision/config hash no longer matches the approved package; a resumed package reconciles all prior attempts first.

cohort.note: Frozen native-only identity (config_name == native__ath_core_v4).  The four-config brief family is descriptive only and is never pooled for GP or advisory comparisons.  run_id is absent on native rows, so independent experiment identity is insufficient_evidence.

task.source_caveat: 2-inch uniform-piston f11 is approximately 3957 Hz; above it the 300-8000 Hz result is a geometry comparison under that excitation, not real 2-inch driver exit behaviour.  Loading weight is 0: no loading/efficiency/ distortion claim.

verification_policy.selection_rule: Up to four distinct screen finalists by actual frozen J, plus two uniformly selected remaining eligible screened designs using the reserved audit RNG seed.  All compared arms receive the same policy.
verification_policy.shortfall: verify fewer designs and report the shortfall; never duplicate or substitute predicted designs
